I'm passionate about leading and developing high performance sales teams, rolling up my sleeves to help AEs win deals, and frantically yelling LETS GOOOO after closed won opportunities drop in the #wins channel. My core pillars are accountability, resourcefulness, and humor.

After graduating from undergrad studying the nerdiest business-y subjects I could find (economics, finance, math) I began working for an options trading firm in downtown Chicago. After a year, I realized the trading world wasn’t for me. Enter: sales.

I started my SaaS sales career in '17 working for Fivestars (acquired by SumUp for $317mm in '21), where I'd cold door knock small business storefronts and sell a $5k/yr loyalty program. After a year and a half, I became the top salesperson at the company out of 125+ active AEs, with 85% of my deals sourced outbound. (Humble brag). 

After nearly four years at Fivestars, I joined Kojo, a vertical SaaS construction procurement tool, as an AE to develop my skills in a longer sales cycle environment. Over the course of a few years, I scaled in sales leadership to eventually become Kojo’s VP Sales in ‘25, leading ~40 sales professionals (AEs, SDRs, SEs). Working at Kojo has been an incredible journey as we continue to scale the business with a major lead in our category.

Outside of work, I'm a dad of 2 (3 y/o son, 1 y/o daughter), a huge Chicago sports fan (Cubs, Bears, Bulls, Hawks) and UW fan (go Dawgs). When I'm not wrangling the kids, I enjoy playing basketball, BBQing, and  listening to trash top 40s music.

column210: VP, Sales / GM, UK and Europe
column213:
How people communicate, shop, and work is changing quickly and direct-to-consumer businesses are at an inflection point. I’ve dedicated my career to helping businesses navigate the ever-changing digital commerce world and better serve their customers.

Businesses have to adapt because the changes are happening around them either way. This is where digital transformation comes in. Digital transformation at its core means adapting to not only new technologies that are available but also to changes in customer expectations, societal shifts, and industry disruptions. Businesses, in responding to these shifts, are needing to become more customer-focused, agile, adaptive to new opportunities, and efficient in order to stay competitive. Digital transformation and smart technology investments are how they can rise to meet these expectations at scale.

In my view, these are exciting times for companies willing to embrace the change and work to become category leaders. Happy to chat about your digital transformation challenges and hopefully we can solve them together.

Prior to role as VP of Sales Engineering & Enablement, I spent most recent years at Connectbase as VP of Product focused on solutioning with customers to innovate the product, enhancing the user experience and The Connected World platform. I am well known by my peers as the trusted advisor and innovator, making a positive impact in a complex fast-moving industry.

I still have my Multiplication Champ t-shirt from learning multiplication tables faster than anyone in the 3rd grade...I loved winning then and nothing has changed. I, to put it lightly, am a competitor.

My fellow co-workers would describe me as analytical, energetic, innovative, empathetic, and willing to do what it takes to get deals across the finish line. These qualities have allowed me to work my way up from internal business development to leading many successful sales teams.

An expert in the art of the consultative, complex sale of enterprise SaaS solutions, my team and I focus on collaboration, attention to detail, and transparency with customers. Our goal is to leverage our industry experience, knowledge of trends/metrics, and understanding of how to implement software efficiently to enhance customer experience, but also shorten sales cycles and increase ACV via value selling.

While I LOVE to win, helping and coaching my team, as well as others across the organization, is the true "Why?" behind my purpose as a leader. I am a continuous learner and am a huge advocate for professional and personal improvement- I push myself and others around me to strive for excellence. My team always has a safe environment to be vulnerable and fail so they are unafraid to take chances, learn, and grow.

--If I am not working then I am reading, hiking, watching documentaries, or spending time with family(proud mama of Michigan State student!)

I started as a software developer, but found my calling in software sales. Helping my clients build a competitive edge through investment in technology is what I do best. If I am not considered a strategic partner, I haven’t done my job.

Always results oriented, I have thrived in a range of sales settings. This includes enterprise account management in a global company - to hunting & disrupting fresh sales patches from a zero-brand startup. All of these environments required me to build talented teams, execute plans in a competitive landscape, develop key relationships, and ultimately drive complex deals from start to finish.

Tech Experience Includes:

-Open source software
-Container and Orchestration software (Docker, kubernetes and related OCI & CNCF projects)
-Middleware portfolios (JBOSS, Fuse, AMQ, Mulesoft, Wildfly, EAP)
-CI / CD (Jenkins)
-Automation
-Custom APIs and curated datastores
-Iaas, Paas, Saas
-Varied experience in Python, C++, AU3, Javascript, MySQL / PLSQL, and other languages

Fun Stuff: camping, fishing, hiking, triathalons/ironman, hang gliding, scuba, snowboarding, all sports- and am now sharing my infinite interests with my two sons.

TLDR: 25+ years of experience in digital and software with roles in sales leadership, engineering, product marketing, and program management. I have a passion for practical business ideas that intersect with technology, and hold 6 cloud developer and architect certifications from AWS, Azure, and GCP. I also have a keen interest in data analytics, machine learning, edge artificial intelligence, and invest in startups within these domains. My goal is to inspire and share learnings as I continue to grow and help others succeed. Thx for following me.

If you really want to know the details:
Follow me to explore leadership & management topics, growth opportunities, change management, go-to-market tips, and cool stuff. This includes ideas and solutions that ultimately make our lives easier and better. 

Why?

I'm passionate about building, coaching, & leading high performance GTM teams. Today I oversee a friggin' awesome team of sales, customer success, business development, marketing, and business operations leaders.

I didn't take a traditional route into software sales or becoming an executive.  I've worn a few hats as an engineer, product marketer, program manager, and sales manager. I have a down-to-earth leadership style and get sh*t done work ethic. And, most importantly, it's all about the customer experience and making customers successful. 

In 3rd grade, I started selling Rubik's cubes to my classmates, ran a newspaper bike route until high school, and sold "double-D edge" knives in college. I enjoy fast-paced and entrepreneurial environments.

I've always been in the digital and software space. As I date myself, I've learned and used technology from my TRS-80 (grade school), 8086 (middle school-Basic), Prime (high school-PASCAL), Sun Sparc20 (college-C/FORTRAN) to the Cloud (Today-Python/SQL). 

Technical experience : enterprise solutions, data analytics, machine learning (beginner level), 5 cloud developer/engineering certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), & other real-world l33t stuff. I hold a BS in computer engineering and an MBA which helps provide a unique perspective to solving business problems using technology. 

And, finally, I've been an angel and early investor in a few startups like Surverybot AI, Hyperice, Skyryse, & Vectara.

Thanks for reading this and following me! I hope to inspire and share learnings as I continue to grow.

Final note: I recognize that there's a lot of "I" in this section. That's not typical.  It's really about "We," "Our," and "Team."

Traditionally, President’s Club is a prestigious award within sales organizations that recognizes top sales people for over-achievement of their goals. Usually these resources are reserved for large-stage companies with established sales programs who can afford to hire top talent. Our goal for President’s Club, LLC is to bring this top talent to early- and mid-stage companies looking to hit aggressive sales metrics, stand out in their market, or use pieces of proven strategies to enhance their existing process.

President’s Club specializes in providing cost effective sales programs and strategies that have proven to dramatically increase pipeline and grow revenue. We have been retained by many early-stage venture funded start-ups and larger privately owned companies to be a complete outsourced sales and marketing solutions or augment existing sales and marketing channels currently in place. We specialize in Seed and Series-A start-ups. The majority of clients have been in the tech / SaaS sector but we’ve worked in many other industries. 

Solutions range from complete outsourced sales and marketing programs to augmentations and enhancements of sales and marketing channels currently in place. Understanding that every business is unique, we build tailored packages to achieve your specific goals. Some examples include:

-Fractional Sales Leadership & Management
-Sales Recruiting, Training, & Planning
-Go-To-Market Planning & Playbook Buildout
-Fractional "President's Club Level" Account Executive
-CRM Implementation & Development
-Pipeline Management and Enterprise Deal Strategy

Our goal for President’s Club, LLC is to bring this top talent to early- and mid-stage companies looking to hit aggressive sales metrics, stand out in their market, or use pieces of proven strategies to enhance their existing process.

President’s Club specializes in providing cost effective sales programs and strategies that have proven to dramatically increase pipeline and grow revenue. -Fractional Sales Leadership & Management

-Go-To-Market Planning & Playbook Buildout
-Fractional "President's Club Level" Account Executive
-CRM Implementation & Development
-Pipeline Management and Enterprise Deal Strategy

- Value Selling and ROI modeling

A go-to-market, strategic partnership and revenue generation specialist with unparalleled soft skills that make a big difference. These skills have served me and my companies well from AI and IoT to electric mobility and nanotechnology. I am also fundamentally a problem solver on every level, and am driven by the belief that proactive creative thinking can always deliver solutions.

My most recent passion to enable shared mobility and Light EV’s in general to play a critical part in urban transportation and a sustainable transportation future. Over the evolution of the still young shared micromobility industry, I have sought to grow and promote new technologies while working closely with various cities to further the cause of responsible deployments as part of the larger public transit ecosystem. As a long-time entrepreneur, I offer an array of skills, including team leadership; startup growth; business development experience, both on the government and commercial side; technical sales and marketing; commercialization of intellectual property; and strategic thinking.

On the personal front, as a generalist I am driven by curiosity and desire to learn about many things. I am, culturally speaking, a citizen of the world and a product of an upbringing based on frequent travel and new experiences that have led me to over 50 countries to date. Having been raised in different countries as a 'third culture kid' has informed my empathy, curiosity, and ability to connect with people from all over the globe. I speak French and Spanish fluently and am conversational in Italian and possess US and French nationalities. 

'Be a part of the solution, not the problem' - constant reminder in my childhood from my Serbian dad.

Honest question: why do B2B marketers feel it's ok to spam (let's not pretend cold email isn't spam) when we hate getting spam in our own business email boxes?

Surely, there is a better way in this day and age than to use spray-and-pray tactics like this. We are talking about reaching folks at the awareness and consideration stage, and if I am aware that you are spamming me, I would never consider your company, even if what you offered was the best solution in the world (unlikely). I can always default to the safe market leader rather than an "early stage" unknown brand.

Would be more interested to see B2B tech companies employ more empathy and less automation.
